purpose: Plain-English training focus → structured coach (tags/weights/curriculum) → train/teach bias; history kept
status: coach-v1 — plain English → tags/weights; train biases loss/sample weights

GET /focus.notes: history newest-first. Empty focus/history/coached when unset. coached is what train uses (tags + loss/sample weights).

body.focus: plain English e.g. stop lights, stop signs, cut-ins

response_200.history: same shape as GET — newest first; entries may include coached

POST /focus.notes: Stores focus + coached + prepends history in .cache/focus_history.json. Deterministic keyword coach (no external LLM call).

POST /jobs/train_all.notes: When set, persisted + passed to train; distill applies sample_weight + dim_weights. Flash stays gated / untouched.

POST /jobs/train.notes: Same optional pass-through; runner accepts focus= and applies coach bias.
